title: Carlisle Companies Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
publisher: Carlisle Companies Incorporated via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Record revenue of $1.6 billion, up 8% year-over-year; adjusted EPS was $7.03 and adjusted EBITDA margin was 26.2%.
summary: Current earnings release furnished to the SEC. Q2 revenue rose 8% to USD 1.570 billion and adjusted EPS rose 12% to USD 7.03, while adjusted EBITDA margin fell 70 basis points to 26.2% as petroleum-derived input and freight inflation outpaced pricing. First-half operating cash flow was USD 197 million and free cash flow was USD 130 million. At June 30 Carlisle held USD 665 million cash against USD 2.890 billion long-term debt including current maturities. Management raised 2026 revenue growth guidance to mid-single digits but now expects a flat adjusted EBITDA margin and increased the 2026 share-repurchase target to USD 1.2 billion.
